title: Treasure Planet
tagline: Stew from a cyborg. Treasure from a planet.
about: A teenage space surfer finds a map to a legendary treasure and signs on as cabin boy aboard a solar galleon.
cue: Serve the mains when Silver serves up his stew in the ship's galley.
